title: Waiting chains and minimal dependencies
current: The steering report, short and full, prints a waiting chains section from the same live blocking edges the Frontier draws, loops excluded. A head that waits on nothing live prints when it holds more than one item, with how many items it unblocks and the chain depth. A blocker still before implementation with no live work claim, while an item behind it is in progress, prints flagged with ! whether it is a head or mid-chain. Each row names the edges it holds with gate, condition and id. Steering guidance keeps dependencies minimal: add an edge only when the dependent needs the blocker's merged code, prefer coordination_only, fact:merged and a specific task, and on every report read staff a flagged blocker or narrow or remove an edge heavier than needed.
